title: Intentful Uses OpenAI Dots to Automate Growth Tasks
summary: Marina Petrova's dot Aria automates proposal building, website research, and message management at Intentful, freeing time for strategic growth work.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Intentful founder Marina Petrova deployed OpenAI's dots platform to build Aria, an AI assistant that automates proposal research and client communications.
- Aria proactively monitors messages, flags urgent items, researches prospect websites, and drafts customized business proposals without manual prompting.
- The automation freed Petrova from administrative tasks, allowing her to focus on strategic client relationships and revenue-generating growth activities.


Marina Petrova, founder of Intentful, a growth consulting firm, faced a familiar challenge: spending hours each week on research, proposal drafting, and inbox management instead of advising clients. After deploying OpenAI's dots platform, she built Aria, an AI assistant that now handles these tasks autonomously. Officially launched on November 24, 2026, the implementation represents a practical case study in how small firms use AI to reclaim strategic time.


## How Aria Handles Proposal Research and Drafting


Aria integrates with Intentful's workflow to research prospect websites, extract key business challenges, and draft customized proposals without manual input. When a new lead enters the pipeline, Aria scans public data sources, identifies growth opportunities, and assembles a preliminary proposal document. Petrova reviews and refines the output, reducing proposal turnaround from days to hours. The system learns from edits, improving accuracy over successive iterations.


## Proactive Message Management and Issue Resolution


Unlike traditional chatbots that wait for queries, Aria monitors Intentful's communication channels continuously. The dot flags urgent client messages, categorizes inquiries by priority, and drafts contextual responses for Petrova's approval. When recurring technical issues arise, Aria cross-references past resolutions and suggests fixes, often resolving problems before they escalate. This proactive approach cut Petrova's daily inbox time by approximately 60 percent, according to internal tracking.


## Integration with Growth Consulting Workflows


Intentful's deployment highlights how dots adapt to domain-specific processes. Aria connects to CRM systems, project management tools, and research databases, creating a unified automation layer. The dot surfaces client engagement metrics, tracks proposal acceptance rates, and suggests outreach timing based on historical patterns. Petrova configured Aria to align with her consulting methodology, ensuring outputs match her firm's voice and strategic frameworks. The flexibility allowed customization without engineering resources.


## Time Savings and Strategic Focus


By automating research and administrative tasks, Petrova redirected effort toward high-value activities: client strategy sessions, relationship building, and revenue expansion. Intentful reported a 40 percent increase in proposals delivered per month after Aria's deployment, while maintaining quality standards. The time reallocation enabled Petrova to take on two additional clients without hiring staff, demonstrating how AI assistants scale small business capacity.


## What This Means for Small Firms


Intentful's experience shows that OpenAI's dots platform extends beyond enterprise use cases. Small consulting practices, agencies, and solo practitioners can deploy custom AI assistants to handle repetitive knowledge work, freeing founders to focus on differentiation and growth. As proactive AI tools mature, the competitive advantage shifts from automation adoption to workflow design and strategic time allocation. Firms that master this balance will likely capture disproportionate growth in AI-augmented service markets.
